caption: The shadow of a cloud sweeps across a sunlit hillside, darkening the grass as it passes.

sa.check: The shadow of a cloud sweeps across it.
The grass darkens as the shadow passes.
The shadow arrives first and the darkening comes with it.

pc.expect: The dark patch moves steadily in one direction, and the grass under it dims and brightens again once it has passed.
pc.fail: The patch jumps; or stops dead; or the grass stays dark after the patch has gone.

pc.expect: The trees' own shadows fade inside the patch and return behind it.
pc.fail: Tree shadows stay sharp inside the cloud shadow; or they vanish outside it; or they point a different way inside it.

pc.expect: The patch darkens the ground and never brightens it.
pc.fail: The ground is brighter inside the patch; or the patch is a colour rather than a darkening; or it glows.

pc.expect: The patch is one soft-edged region.
pc.fail: It has a hard geometric edge; or splits into many small patches; or forms a recognisable object shape.

pc.expect: The hillside keeps its trees and features.
pc.fail: Trees appear or vanish as the shadow passes; or the hillside changes shape; or the patch becomes a solid object.

pc.expect: The grass colour and the landscape stay the same apart from the dimming.
pc.fail: The grass changes colour rather than brightness; or the landscape rearranges; or the sky changes.
